medium.en: Hanging scroll; ink and colour on silk

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: Purchase, John M. Crawford Jr. Bequest, 1992

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1462. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1462 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: On darkened silk, a lone man hunched against the cold, arms drawn up to his face, hurries along a snowy bank beneath a grove of tall bare winter trees; a fence is half hidden among the trees, and snowy hills and water fade into a dim sky behind.
alt.zh: 在变暗的绢上，一个孤身的人顶着寒冷弓着身，双臂缩到脸前，沿着积雪的河岸匆匆走在一片高大的冬日枯树下；树丛里半掩着篱笆，身后的雪山和水面隐入昏暗的天色。

note.en: Dai Jin was the leading painter of the Zhe school in the early Ming, and this is a late work. The silk has darkened with age, so the snow now reads as a soft gold-grey, and the eye needs a moment to adjust. The subject is simple and kind: someone almost home at the end of a cold day.
note.zh: 戴进是明初浙派的领袖人物，这是他晚年的作品。绢色经年变深，雪如今看起来是一种柔和的金灰色，眼睛需要一会儿才能适应。题材简单而温厚：一个人在寒冷的一天结束时，快到家了。
